item.subject: science
item.stem:
Inder wants a fair comparison of two household liquids using one prepared red-rose extract as the indicator.

Which plan makes that comparison fair?

options.A: Use the same rose extract for both, add comparable amounts of each liquid with a dropper, and record the final colour for each sample.
options.B: Use one drop of sample A and ten drops of sample B; the test is still fair if the indicator is the same and both final colours are written down.
options.C: If both samples can later be labelled acid or base, the comparison must have been fair no matter how it was done.
options.D: He also keeps a separate turmeric-paper demo for a different lesson; that separate demo makes today's rose-extract comparison unfair.
